[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-ti[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make the commit finalizer's protection baseline truthful[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A turn's own work is never mistaken for foreign dirt. The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dirty-path baseline is captured before the agent can write, every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]consumer reads it through one contract, the finalizer refuses to [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dispatch a stitch that protection has already emptied, and a stitch[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]failure reports the reason the VCS provider actually gave instead [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]of spending a whole attempt budget on an identical, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]guaranteed-to-fail retry.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]commit_finalizer_protection_truth.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/commit_finalizer_protection_truth.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-ti[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-ti/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One baseline, one answer about who owns a path[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]scope[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]scope: give finalizer_baseline.json a single documented read contract so[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the evidence an agent reads and the protection the dispatcher applies [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]can never contradict each other for the same repository path, and pin [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that with an invariant test.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Baseline every checkout that exists before the first turn[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]checkouts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after scope[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]checkouts: snapshot every repository checkout already present in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workspace at runner start rather than only the dirty ones, and make a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]later repo open unable to rebase an existing record for the same path [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]onto the agent's own work.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Repair run-written path attribution outside the primary repo[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]attribution[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]attribution: stop discarding the absolute tool-call path before the only[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]code that can relativize it against a repository root, so direct writes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into linked, sidecar, and external repos are visible to both the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]declaration evidence and the deferral counter-evidence check.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Never dispatch a stitch that protection has already emptied[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after scope[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: detect before dispatch that every changed path in a repository is[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]excluded, refuse the doomed sase stitch create, and raise a specific [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]non-retryable diagnostic that names the protected paths and the baseline[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record that protected them.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Truthful stitch failures and a retry budget that cannot be [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]wasted[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]fidelity[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fidelity: carry the VCS provider's real reason through the failure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]message, diagnostics, and error report, and stop spending a second [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mutating attempt on a failure whose inputs are provably identical to the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]first.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Replay the failure end to end and land the tree[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after checkouts, attribution, guard, fidelity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify: add a live end-to-end regression that reproduces the original [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]research.13.cdx sequence and now commits, then run the full landing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gate.[/#D7D7AF]
